title: Order Summary
description: A read-only order summary, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button, Card, Divider and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading, one line per item (its image, linked name, options, quantity and price) and a muted Card with the totals rows, a Divider and the total, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the image grows and each line's quantity moves into its own column at @sm, the image grows again and the heading steps up at @md, and the totals move beside the lines at @lg.
